title: About this BC demo
intro: CropLytics runs the same pick → now → season → compare → print path here on an illustrative Salmon River forage field. NASA POWER weather and AAFC crop history are real at this point. Soil, the field outline, and some regional layers are illustrative until denser BC ground data is wired.

lines.label: Weather
lines.text: NASA POWER at the field point drives the rotation water model (Salmon Arm CS is the nearest Environment Canada station).

lines.label: Crops
lines.text: AAFC Annual Crop Inventory labels this point as pasture/forages across recent years.

lines.label: Water story
lines.text: Lower Salmon River surface licences; August 2023 fish-protection orders stopped forage irrigation in this valley.

lines.label: Still illustrative
lines.text: Field outline is a square on a stable forage pixel (not a surveyed parcel). Soil and some satellite calendars are labelled when they are examples.

limit: Sumas Prairie is not a second field yet. Gaps stay in the source lines, not as a dead end.

news.title: Fish population protection orders: about 398 licence holders told to stop watering forage crops

next_step.label: Same workflow as the CA build; this field is the BC demo
